headlines.title: UPS (UPS) Stock May Be 46% Undervalued On Fresh AI Data Center News
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service has delivered a sharp rebound in its share price over the past year, and the question now is whether the cash the business can generate is enough to support where the stock trades today. Over the past 5 years the stock has fallen 33.5%, which puts the recent recovery in sharper focus for anyone asking if today’s valuation is really grounded in the company’s underlying cash flows.

headlines.title: How to Build $9,800 a Month in Dividend Income Without Selling a Single Share
headlines.summary: One retiree wants a six-figure income stream that never forces a sale, even when markets crash. Six holdings could pull it off, but three of them carry paychecks most likely to shrink. Which ones deserve your suspicion?

headlines.title: Longtime Franchisee Takes on Second Location with Opening of New Pak Mail in Westminster, Colorado
headlines.summary: Annex Brands, Inc., one of the leading franchisors in the packing, shipping and office services industries, is excited to announce the opening of its newest Pak Mail location in Westminster, Colorado to owner Manny Zussman. This new Pak Mail is set to offer a wide range of essential shipping and office services to the local community, making it easier to provide more service to more people in more places.

headlines.title: Longtime Montclair, Virginia Location Transitions to New Ownership After 28 Years of Service
headlines.summary: Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of a Pak Mail location in Montclair, Virginia to new owner Sayed Mawzoon. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will benefit from the essential Shipping and Office Services provided by this Pak Mail location for the past 28 years.

headlines.title: Longtime Red Lion, Pennsylvania Location Transitions to New Ownership After 18 Years of Service
headlines.summary: Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of a Postal Connections location in Red Lion, Pennsylvania to new owner Derick Kober. description: United Parcel Service, Inc., a package delivery and logistics provider, offers transportation and delivery services. It operates through two segments, U.S. Domestic Package and International Package. The U.S. Domestic Package segment offers time-definite delivery services for express letters, documents, packages and palletized freight through air and ground services. The International Package segment provides small package operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Latin America, and Asia. The company offers a range of guaranteed day- and time-definite international transportation services; day-definite services; cross-border ground package delivery; contract-only, e-commerce solutions for non-urgent, and cross-border shipments; and international service for urgent and palletized shipments. It also provides international air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage and insurance, mail services, healthcare logistics, distribution, and post-sales services. United Parcel Service, Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
